Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BA/MEng at University of Cambridge

What University of Cambridge asks of applicants to Computer Science BA/MEng for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Cambridge courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma: the diploma alone is not considered suitable preparation — typically AP tests plus the SAT and/or ACT
  • With APs: SAT at least 1500 (Mathematics 750+), or ACT composite 33 out of 36 with an ACT Science score of at least 33
Verified19 Oct 2026Cambridge: International entry requirements
English language
  • Required if you are not from a majority English-speaking country (UK Home Office definition)
  • Minimum for admission:
    • IELTS Academic normally 7.5 overall, usually with 7.0 or above in each element
    • or Cambridge C2 Proficiency 200 (no element below 185)
    • or C1 Advanced 193 (no element below 185) with other evidence
  • For interview, Cambridge recommends at least IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (no element below 6.0) at the point of application
  • The College making the offer sets the exact English condition

No TOEFL or PTE score is listed on this page. The same requirement applies to every Cambridge course.

Verified19 Oct 2026Cambridge: Entry requirements
Admissions tests
  • TMUA (Test of Mathematics for University Admission) — required for all applicants
  • CSAT (Computer Sciences Aptitude Test) — also required for applicants to Peterhouse or Trinity

The CSAT is College-specific (Peterhouse, Trinity); it is not in the matching engine.

Verified19 Oct 2026Cambridge: Computer Science
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics
  • Further Mathematics (AS or A level): required if your school offers it

Official (2027 entry): Further Mathematics is required where available, not just preferred.

Further Mathematics

Official (2027 entry): A*A*A; Mathematics required, and Further Mathematics to AS or A level is required if the school offers it (otherwise contact the College). Colleges usually require A* in Mathematics and/or Further Mathematics. Minimum offer level for 2027 entry; Colleges may set higher or more specific offers (e.g. an A* in a named subject).

Details
776 at HL

Cambridge publishes a minimum of 41–42 points with 776 at HL (the exact figure is set by the College); 41 is the lower end. Some Colleges (e.g. Churchill, Corpus Christi, Selwyn) usually make IB offers above the minimum.

Verified19 Oct 2026Cambridge: Computer Science
Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma: a minimum of five AP scores at grade 5 in subjects related to the course, plus a high SAT or ACT score and a high overall GPA
  • For courses asking for A-level Mathematics and Further Mathematics, AP Calculus BC is strongly preferred; for courses asking for A-level Physics, the two Physics C tests are preferred
Verified19 Oct 2026Cambridge: International entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Interviews:
    • every applicant made an offer has been interviewed
    • main interview period 7–18 December 2026
    • format and number vary by College
  • Written work not usually required
